style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: half-squeezed shut with tears brimming but not yet falling — wetness pooling at the lower lid, lashes clumped together, eye corners red
expression_signature.brows: drawn up and together — the opposite direction of anger, this is the 'about to cry in self-pity' configuration
expression_signature.mouth: pushed forward into a trembling pout, lower lip pushed out and quivering, the upper lip curled slightly inward, a child-like protest face, not a snarl
expression_signature.cheeks: wet with the first tear tracks, foundation streaked downward with the tear path
expression_signature.head: thrown slightly to one side in a 'poor me' tilt, hair in disarray
expression_signature.overall_impression: the 'I'm the victim here' face — used on Page 13 (defending her gossip about the friend) and Page 14 ('你要不给我钱要不给我时间要不给我自由，我倒好啥都没捞着')

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top + light grey high-waisted yoga leggings
inherit_from_base.default_posture_override: one hand clutching own chest or the sofa cushion, body language turned half-away from husband in theatrical grievance

micro_motion.static: half-turned away, one hand on chest, lower lip trembling
micro_motion.subtle_motion: a single fat tear rolling down one cheek; shoulders shaking with one fake sob; fingers digging into the sofa cushion; chin quivering

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: warm TV-backlight glow on her face when sitting on sofa, the rest of the room in cool shadow — the artificial warmth frames her 'victim' performance
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: harsh overhead light — would make the tears look ugly rather than manipulative

voice_lines_examples: 我真是没事找事，还好心喊你起来吃早饭

snarling mouth (this is pout, not snarl)
